## Modules

- [Alike](https://alike.hexdocs.pm/Alike.md): Semantic similarity testing for Elixir.
- [Alike.Models.Embedding](https://alike.hexdocs.pm/Alike.Models.Embedding.md): Sentence embedding model for semantic similarity.
- [Alike.Models.NLI](https://alike.hexdocs.pm/Alike.Models.NLI.md): Natural Language Inference model for contradiction detection.
- [Alike.Similarity](https://alike.hexdocs.pm/Alike.Similarity.md): Core semantic similarity detection using sentence embeddings and NLI.
- [Alike.WaveOperator](https://alike.hexdocs.pm/Alike.WaveOperator.md): Defines the `<~>` wave operator for semantic similarity assertions.
